nodes.summary: If the Boolean result of the SAT verifier, as a function of pairs (formula code, assignment), is computable in polynomial time, then the language of bit strings that encode a satisfiable CNF formula in the binary-index encoding is in NP, and every decision problem in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
nodes.title: Cook–Levin for binary-index CNF-SAT, given a polynomial-time verifier

nodes.summary: The translation of bit strings from the dense CNF encoding to the binary-index CNF encoding, as a function on all bit strings, is polynomial-time computable with respect to the canonical bitstring encoding of bit lists.
nodes.title: The dense-to-binary translation is polynomial-time in the canonical encoding

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be an encoding of a machine $M$, let $x$ and $Y$ be lists of input symbols of $M$, let $a$ be a symbol of its output stack, and let $m, T \in \mathbb{N}$. Put $H = m + (T + 1)d + 1$, where $d$ is the window depth of $M$. Then every clause of the Cook–Levin formula $\Phi(E, x, Y, a, m, T)$ is a dense clause of length $(T + 1)(A + K H g)$, the number of variables of the layout of $E$ at time bound $T$ and…
nodes.title: Every clause of the Cook–Levin formula has one slot per variable

nodes.summary: Every decision problem $L$ in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to the language of bit strings that encode a satisfiable CNF formula in the binary-index encoding.
nodes.title: Every NP problem reduces to binary-index CNF-SAT

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
